paragraphs: Rav Papa, son of Rav Chanan of Bei Kluchit, or Tzluchit.
Mentioned in [Ketubot 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.40b.12), speaking before Rav Shimi bar Ashi.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Bei Kluchit. Hyman also records Tzluchit.
[Heilprin’s entry on Rav Chanan](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1410&lang=en) uses Tzeluchit and mentions his son Rav Pappa before Shimi bar Ashi.
In the linked passage, Rav Pappa repeats a teaching to Rav Shimi bar Ashi, who gives a different setting for it.
